SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.MobileCrisisStatsMapper."selectmobileCrisisStats" : (모바일)위기상담 유형별 통계*/ TYPENAME AS TYPENAME , SUM(L1) AS L1 , SUM(L2) AS L2 , SUM(L3) AS L3 , SUM(L4) AS L4 , SUM(L5) AS L5 , SUM(L6) AS L6 , SUM(L7) AS L7 , SUM(L8) AS L8 , SUM(L9) AS L9 , SUM(L10) AS L10 , SUM(TOTAL) AS TOTAL FROM ( SELECT '모바일' AS TYPENAME /*모바일*/ , CASE WHEN CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '01' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END AS L1 , CASE WHEN CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '02' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END AS L2 , CASE WHEN CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '03' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END AS L3 , CASE WHEN CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '04' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END AS L4 , CASE WHEN CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '05' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END AS L5 , CASE WHEN CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '06' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END AS L6 , CASE WHEN CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '07' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END AS L7 , CASE WHEN CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '08' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END AS L8 , CASE WHEN CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '09' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END AS L9 , CASE WHEN CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '99' OR CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD IS NULL THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END AS L10 , COUNT(*) AS TOTAL FROM AYA120 WHERE FRST_REG_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') + 0.99999 AND EXISTS (SELECT 'Y' FROM AYB200 WHERE AYA120.CHRO_NO = AYB200.CHRO_NO AND AYB200.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AYB200.CHTT_TYPE_SE_CD IN ('2', '3', '4') )
AND ( YNGBGS_DSCSN_WLFAR_CNTER_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD = '1' /*직접연계*/ OR FAM_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD = '1' OR DT_CACE_SHELTR_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD = '1' OR EMRG_RESC_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD = '1' OR LEADER_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD = '1' OR ETC_SPCLTY_INST_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD = '1' )
GROUP BY CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD UNION ALL SELECT '오픈채팅' AS TYPENAME /*오픈채팅*/ , CASE WHEN CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '01' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END AS L1 , CASE WHEN CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '02' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END AS L2 , CASE WHEN CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '03' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END AS L3 , CASE WHEN CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '04' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END AS L4 , CASE WHEN CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '05' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END AS L5 , CASE WHEN CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '06' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END AS L6 , CASE WHEN CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '07' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END AS L7 , CASE WHEN CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '08' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END AS L8 , CASE WHEN CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '09' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END AS L9 , CASE WHEN CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '99' OR CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD IS NULL THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END AS L10 , COUNT(*) AS TOTAL FROM AYA120 WHERE BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '18' AND (CHRO_NO IS NULL OR CHRO_NO = '' ) AND FRST_REG_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') + 0.99999
AND ( YNGBGS_DSCSN_WLFAR_CNTER_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD = '1' /*직접연계*/ OR FAM_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD = '1' OR DT_CACE_SHELTR_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD = '1' OR EMRG_RESC_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD = '1' OR LEADER_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD = '1' OR ETC_SPCLTY_INST_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD = '1' )
GROUP BY CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD ) A GROUP BY TYPENAME

SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.MobileCrisisStatsMapper."selectmobileCrisisStatsCounselor" : (모바일)위기상담 상담자별 통계*/ (SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(SCA100.FLNM_ENCPT) FROM SCA100 , SAA200 WHERE TYPENAME = SAA200.USER_ID AND SAA200.ENFSN_NO = SCA100.ENFSN_NO AND DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS TYPENAME , SUM(L1) AS L1 , SUM(L2) AS L2 , SUM(L3) AS L3 , SUM(L4) AS L4 , SUM(L5) AS L5 , SUM(L6) AS L6 , SUM(L7) AS L7 , SUM(L8) AS L8 , SUM(L9) AS L9 , SUM(L10) AS L10 , SUM(TOTAL) AS TOTAL FROM ( SELECT FRST_RGTR_ID AS TYPENAME /*모바일*/ , CASE WHEN CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '01' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END AS L1 , CASE WHEN CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '02' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END AS L2 , CASE WHEN CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '03' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END AS L3 , CASE WHEN CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '04' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END AS L4 , CASE WHEN CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '05' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END AS L5 , CASE WHEN CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '06' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END AS L6 , CASE WHEN CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '07' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END AS L7 , CASE WHEN CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '08' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END AS L8 , CASE WHEN CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '09' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END AS L9 , CASE WHEN CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '99' OR CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD IS NULL THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END AS L10 , COUNT(*) AS TOTAL FROM AYA120
WHERE FRST_REG_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') + 0.99999
AND ( YNGBGS_DSCSN_WLFAR_CNTER_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD = '1' /*직접연계*/ OR FAM_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD = '1' OR DT_CACE_SHELTR_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD = '1' OR EMRG_RESC_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD = '1' OR LEADER_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD = '1' OR ETC_SPCLTY_INST_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD = '1' )
AND ( BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = 18 AND (CHRO_NO IS NULL OR CHRO_NO = '' ) OR EXISTS (SELECT 'Y' FROM AYB200 WHERE AYA120.CHRO_NO = AYB200.CHRO_NO AND AYB200.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AYB200.CHTT_TYPE_SE_CD IN ('2', '3', '4') ) ) GROUP BY FRST_RGTR_ID , CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD ) A GROUP BY TYPENAME ORDER BY 1
